info.disabled: NR disabled: nr.enabled is false in config/config.json
info.modelCopied: NR model copied next to the game executable: {0} ({1})
info.unloaded: NR unloaded: feature, textures and model released (enabling it again rebuilds them)
info.hotkeyReset: NR and engine DLSS history reset (hotkey)

warn.rebuildFailed: Resolution changed: NR rebuild failed ({0:#x}: {1}); {2}x{3} is not applied
warn.rebuildLimit: Resolution changed too often; NR stops following it (already rebuilt {0} times)
warn.hardlinkFailed: Hard link failed (error {0}); copying {1} into the game directory instead...
warn.scaleFailed: Input scaling unavailable: creating the {0}% feature failed, falling back to 100% for this run (NR still works)
warn.afterFallback: After-upscaling placement could not be created; this run fell back to before upscaling (restart to try again)
warn.modelReplaceFailed: Could not replace the NR model next to the game executable (error {0}: {1}); keeping the existing file
warn.modelPickMissing: The picked NR model {0} does not exist; using the default nvngx_dlssnr.dll

error.noExeDir: Could not determine the game executable directory; NR unavailable
error.modelMissing: NR model missing: {0} does not exist, NR unavailable. Put nvngx_dlssnr.dll into the mod folder
error.modelUnwritable: Game directory is not writable: cannot place the NR model at {0} (hard link error {1}, copy error {2}). Copy {3} to {0} manually
error.createFailed: NR creation failed ({0:#x}: {1}); NR unavailable for this run
error.evalFailed: NR evaluation failed ({0:#x}: {1}); the frame keeps its previous content (attempt {2})
error.missingExport: NGX core is missing the export {0}; NR cannot work
error.hookFailed: Failed to hook {0}; NR cannot work

replace.hint5: The network's relative gain is multiplied back onto the engine's linear HDR picture, then the engine's DLSS upscales it.
replace.hint6: TRP's Ratio composite: rebased onto the original luminance, highlights come from the original, and the four Ratio parameters below act on it.

style.skinHint: Test build only: -1 follows Local structure, 0-2 is an independent strength. On Minecraft content -1/0/1 showed no measurable difference (docs/L P1), so the release UI no longer offers it.

neural.disabledHint: Neural rendering is off; these values take effect once it is enabled again.
neural.placementHint: Before: NR runs at the render resolution and its result becomes the engine DLSS input (default, ~3.5 ms at 1440p). After: NR runs at the output resolution on top of DLSS and writes the final HDR back; grading and UI still belong to the engine (~9.6 ms). The sides are exclusive; switching rebuilds the feature and resets both histories.
neural.placementAfterHint: The after side runs at 100% of the output resolution, about 4x the cost of the before side; the 66% cost-reduction stage comes after this batch is accepted.
neural.afterFallbackHint: The after side could not be created; this run fell back to before upscaling (restart to try again).
neural.mvHint: Auto = normalised by the render size (recommended). A manual value is the MV pixel scale.
neural.encodeHint: NR consumes a display-referred picture; the encode decides how the engine's linear HDR becomes display-referred.
neural.toneHint: Scales the wide and local parts of NR's change separately; 1.00 = unchanged; Replace=6 only.
neural.exposureHint: Derives the white point from the frame's average brightness (indoor and outdoor scenes look similar to NR); the EV bias shifts what NR sees. Note: the ratio resolve cancels most of the white point, so the visible difference can be tiny (2026-10-24: not measurable by eye); judging it needs a white-point read-back.
neural.networkHint: Read only when the NR feature is created, so a change needs a game restart. Measured at 1485x835: the previous network is much slower (evaluate 3.2 -> 5.8 ms); the default one is faster.
neural.compareHint: Left half stays the engine's original frame (no NR), right half is the composite, with a dark seam; for judging what NR actually changed.
neural.scaleHint: NR runs at this resolution and is composited back to full size; lower saves GPU time, judge the detail loss with the split comparison. Changing it rebuilds the feature (one hitch).
neural.scaleAfterHint: After upscaling always runs at 100% of the output resolution; input scaling applies to the before side only (the 66% cost stage is docs/N P3).
neural.modelHint: nvngx_dlssnr*.dll files in the mod directory; the pick replaces the model next to the game executable on the next start (the core only accepts the name nvngx_dlssnr.dll).

diag.hint: Timings come from a timestamp query ring; only frames completed inside a window are counted.
diag.resetSr: Reset engine SR history every frame
diag.warnHint: All three break the picture on purpose; they exist to locate problems. Logs go to the mod directory.
diag.vvNotReady: waiting for the engine's first frame
diag.vvHint: Screen turns the clear colour with the UI still drawn => the cut is before the UI; the whole screen turns => after it; nothing changes => a later list overwrote it (raise k).
diag.vvReasonFence: previous injection still on the GPU
diag.vvTail: Count from the tail (k=1 = end of frame)

adv.scaleHint: Use the - / + buttons in the title bar; the scale follows the resolution.
adv.openHint: Click the button, then press and release the new key or combination, in order; Esc keeps the current binding (the panel key cannot be empty), Reset restores the default.
adv.conflictExact: Same combination as "{0}": the two fight, only the first match fires.
adv.conflictOverlap: Prefix overlap with "{0}": the shorter one fires first.
adv.nrKeyHint: Works while the panel is closed; press Apply first.
adv.resetKeyHint: Works while the panel is closed; wipes NR and engine DLSS history together.
adv.screenshotHint: Click the button, then press and release the new key or combination (Esc clears it). The finished frame (HUD included, panel excluded) is saved as PNG under the game folder's screenshots/.
adv.configHint: The config is imported at startup only; Apply affects this run, Save as default also writes config/config.json.

sr.cbNone: No callback seen yet: it appears with ray tracing on, inside a world.
sr.cbHint: Increments on every engine call; the engine builds its render targets from the size it returns.
sr.resetHint: Use when the picture smears after a teleport or camera cut: writes Reset=1 for one frame.
sr.scaleHint: Sets the DLSS quality slot and the scene render size (FrameBuilder factor) together, so both sides always agree; it rebuilds immediately. 33/50/58/66/100 map to the engine's native DLSS slots; 75% has no native slot and is not offered. Defaults to the engine value.
sr.modelHint: Writes all six DLSS.Hint.Render.Preset quality hints (keeping the high bit the engine sets). It only applies at CreateFeature, so it needs one rebuild: change the internal resolution or re-enter the world.
sr.sharpHint: Runs RCAS (AMD contrast-adaptive sharpening) on the finished frame, after the engine's DLSS and before its colour grading and UI composition. Strength scales the sharpening delta by 0-4x (default 0.672 is about 2.7x; the top can show halos). The HUD and text are never sharpened. The image is linear HDR, so the pass maps through Reinhard to 0-1 first. Applies immediately; no DLSS rebuild. Judge it by toggling it on the whole frame - the only split comparison left is on the Neural Rendering page, and that one is for NR.
sr.sharpZeroHint: Strength 0 records no pass; same as off.
sr.sharpOffHint: Off records no pass: zero cost.
sr.ctxNone: No engine frame context seen yet (it appears inside a world).
sr.checkHint: All four should read ok; the factor table is only located after the first world load. A FAILED row means a game update moved a signature and SR will silently do nothing - see the [sr] line in the log.
sr.backendLost: Last seen {0} ago; nothing is running now (out of a world, or upscaling is off).
sr.backendConfigured: The engine is set to VV, but upscaling is not running (ratio {0}%; 100% turns it off). Pick a lower ratio below to bring it back.
sr.vvEnableHint: On: our DLSS writes into TAAU's output (arg10) and the engine's TAAU draw is skipped. Off: the engine's own TAAU, nothing of ours runs. Requires an upscaling ratio below 100% (at 100% there is no TAAU to replace).
sr.backendNever: No SR backend detected: VV needs upscaling = TAAU with a ratio below 100%; ray tracing needs ray tracing enabled.
sr.scaleHintVv: Writes the engine option upscaling_percentage; it applies live, without a restart or F11. 100% turns upscaling off entirely: TAAU disappears and this page has nothing left to replace.
sr.sharpHintVv: Sharpening is not wired up on the VV path yet: the RCAS pass hangs off the engine's EvaluateFeature, while VV writes arg10 from our own pipeline.
sr.resetHintVv: Use it when the picture smears after a teleport or a camera cut: clears the DLSS history for two frames.

stage.nrCreate: creating the NR feature (textures, shaders, model)
